name: rekognition
description: This is the API Reference for Amazon Rekognition Image, Amazon Rekognition Custom Labels, Amazon Rekognition Stored Video, Amazon Rekognition Streaming Video.

subcommands.name: associate-faces
subcommands.description: Associates one or more faces with an existing UserID.

subcommands.name: compare-faces
subcommands.description: Compares a face in the source input image with each of the 100 largest faces detected in the target input image.

subcommands.name: copy-project-version
subcommands.description: This operation applies only to Amazon Rekognition Custom Labels.

subcommands.name: create-collection
subcommands.description: Creates a collection in an AWS Region.

subcommands.name: create-dataset
subcommands.description: This operation applies only to Amazon Rekognition Custom Labels.

subcommands.name: create-face-liveness-session
subcommands.description: This API operation initiates a Face Liveness session.

subcommands.name: create-project
subcommands.description: Creates a new Amazon Rekognition project.

subcommands.name: create-project-version
subcommands.description: Creates a new version of Amazon Rekognition project (like a Custom Labels model or a custom adapter) and begins training.

subcommands.name: create-stream-processor
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon Rekognition stream processor that you can use to detect and recognize faces or to detect labels in a streaming video.

subcommands.name: create-user
subcommands.description: Creates a new User within a collection specified by CollectionId.

subcommands.name: delete-collection
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified collection.

subcommands.name: delete-dataset
subcommands.description: This operation applies only to Amazon Rekognition Custom Labels.

subcommands.name: delete-faces
subcommands.description: Deletes faces from a collection.

subcommands.name: delete-project
subcommands.description: Deletes a Amazon Rekognition project.

subcommands.name: delete-project-policy
subcommands.description: This operation applies only to Amazon Rekognition Custom Labels.

subcommands.name: delete-project-version
subcommands.description: Deletes a Rekognition project model or project version, like a Amazon Rekognition Custom Labels model or a custom adapter.

subcommands.name: delete-stream-processor
subcommands.description: Deletes the stream processor identified by Name.

subcommands.name: delete-user
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified UserID within the collection.

subcommands.name: describe-collection
subcommands.description: Describes the specified collection.

subcommands.name: describe-dataset
subcommands.description: This operation applies only to Amazon Rekognition Custom Labels.

subcommands.name: describe-project-versions
subcommands.description: Lists and describes the versions of an Amazon Rekognition project.

subcommands.name: describe-projects
subcommands.description: Gets information about your Rekognition projects.

subcommands.name: describe-stream-processor
subcommands.description: Provides information about a stream processor created by CreateStreamProcessor.

subcommands.name: detect-custom-labels
subcommands.description: This operation applies only to Amazon Rekognition Custom Labels.

subcommands.name: detect-faces
subcommands.description: Detects faces within an image that is provided as input.

subcommands.name: detect-labels
subcommands.description: Detects instances of real-world entities within an image (JPEG or PNG) provided as input.

subcommands.name: detect-moderation-labels
subcommands.description: Detects unsafe content in a specified JPEG or PNG format image.

subcommands.name: detect-protective-equipment
subcommands.description: Detects Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) worn by people detected in an image.

subcommands.name: detect-text
subcommands.description: Detects text in the input image and converts it into machine-readable text.

subcommands.name: disassociate-faces
subcommands.description: Removes the association between a Face supplied in an array of FaceIds and the User.

subcommands.name: distribute-dataset-entries
subcommands.description: This operation applies only to Amazon Rekognition Custom Labels.

subcommands.name: get-celebrity-info
subcommands.description: Gets the name and additional information about a celebrity based on their Amazon Rekognition ID.

subcommands.name: get-celebrity-recognition
subcommands.description: Gets the celebrity recognition results for a Amazon Rekognition Video analysis started by StartCelebrityRecognition.

subcommands.name: get-content-moderation
subcommands.description: Gets the inappropriate, unwanted, or offensive content analysis results for a Amazon Rekognition Video analysis started by StartContentModeration.

subcommands.name: get-face-detection
subcommands.description: Gets face detection results for a Amazon Rekognition Video analysis started by StartFaceDetection.

subcommands.name: get-face-liveness-session-results
subcommands.description: Retrieves the results of a specific Face Liveness session.

subcommands.name: get-face-search
subcommands.description: Gets the face search results for Amazon Rekognition Video face search started by StartFaceSearch.

subcommands.name: get-label-detection
subcommands.description: Gets the label detection results of a Amazon Rekognition Video analysis started by StartLabelDetection.

subcommands.name: get-media-analysis-job
subcommands.description: Retrieves the results for a given media analysis job.

subcommands.name: get-person-tracking
subcommands.description: End of support notice: On October 31, 2025, AWS will discontinue support for Amazon Rekognition People Pathing.

subcommands.name: get-segment-detection
subcommands.description: Gets the segment detection results of a Amazon Rekognition Video analysis started by StartSegmentDetection.

subcommands.name: get-text-detection
subcommands.description: Gets the text detection results of a Amazon Rekognition Video analysis started by StartTextDetection.

subcommands.name: index-faces
subcommands.description: Detects faces in the input image and adds them to the specified collection.

subcommands.name: list-collections
subcommands.description: Returns list of collection IDs in your account.

subcommands.name: list-dataset-entries
subcommands.description: This operation applies only to Amazon Rekognition Custom Labels.

subcommands.name: list-dataset-labels
subcommands.description: This operation applies only to Amazon Rekognition Custom Labels.

subcommands.name: list-faces
subcommands.description: Returns metadata for faces in the specified collection.

subcommands.name: list-media-analysis-jobs
subcommands.description: Returns a list of media analysis jobs.

subcommands.name: list-project-policies
subcommands.description: This operation applies only to Amazon Rekognition Custom Labels.

subcommands.name: list-stream-processors
subcommands.description: Gets a list of stream processors that you have created with CreateStreamProcessor.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns a list of tags in an Amazon Rekognition collection, stream processor, or Custom Labels model.

subcommands.name: list-users
subcommands.description: Returns metadata of the User such as UserID in the specified collection.

subcommands.name: put-project-policy
subcommands.description: This operation applies only to Amazon Rekognition Custom Labels.

subcommands.name: recognize-celebrities
subcommands.description: Returns an array of celebrities recognized in the input image.

subcommands.name: search-faces
subcommands.description: For a given input face ID, searches for matching faces in the collection the face belongs to.

subcommands.name: search-faces-by-image
subcommands.description: For a given input image, first detects the largest face in the image, and then searches the specified collection for matching faces.

subcommands.name: search-users
subcommands.description: Searches for UserIDs within a collection based on a FaceId or UserId.

subcommands.name: search-users-by-image
subcommands.description: Searches for UserIDs using a supplied image.

subcommands.name: start-celebrity-recognition
subcommands.description: Starts asynchronous recognition of celebrities in a stored video.

subcommands.name: start-content-moderation
subcommands.description: Starts asynchronous detection of inappropriate, unwanted, or offensive content in a stored video.

subcommands.name: start-face-detection
subcommands.description: Starts asynchronous detection of faces in a stored video.

subcommands.name: start-face-search
subcommands.description: Starts the asynchronous search for faces in a collection that match the faces of persons detected in a stored video.

subcommands.name: start-label-detection
subcommands.description: Starts asynchronous detection of labels in a stored video.

subcommands.name: start-media-analysis-job
subcommands.description: Initiates a new media analysis job.

subcommands.name: start-person-tracking
subcommands.description: End of support notice: On October 31, 2025, AWS will discontinue support for Amazon Rekognition People Pathing.

subcommands.name: start-project-version
subcommands.description: This operation applies only to Amazon Rekognition Custom Labels.

subcommands.name: start-segment-detection
subcommands.description: Starts asynchronous detection of segment detection in a stored video.

subcommands.name: start-stream-processor
subcommands.description: Starts processing a stream processor.

subcommands.name: start-text-detection
subcommands.description: Starts asynchronous detection of text in a stored video.

subcommands.name: stop-project-version
subcommands.description: This operation applies only to Amazon Rekognition Custom Labels.

subcommands.name: stop-stream-processor
subcommands.description: Stops a running stream processor that was created by CreateStreamProcessor.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds one or more key-value tags to an Amazon Rekognition collection, stream processor, or Custom Labels model.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from an Amazon Rekognition collection, stream processor, or Custom Labels model.

subcommands.name: update-dataset-entries
subcommands.description: This operation applies only to Amazon Rekognition Custom Labels.

subcommands.name: update-stream-processor
subcommands.description: Allows you to update a stream processor.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: project-version-running
subcommands.description: Wait until the ProjectVersion is running.

subcommands.name: project-version-training-completed
subcommands.description: Wait until the ProjectVersion training completes.
